name: QScan + coherence soft shrinkage
registered: 2026-10-24, before any combined result was computed
question: Do the data-driven common-Q correction (QScanRefit, bae_q_20261024) and neighbour-coherence shrinkage (coherence_soft v1/v2) add up?
pipeline: QScan: scan c in exp(linspace(log 0.6, log 2.2, 13)), minimise the gather-summed lasso objective (unchanged from qscan_refit.m), applied Q = used Q * c. Then FullCalRefit, SoftGroupRefit and the coherence gains are computed at that Q with the frozen rules: v1 (1, 8) and Standard (0.5, 16). Same observation, sigma, wavelet and blocks for every method.

data.development: V4 (four-layer) and V5 (complex), already seen in coherence_soft_v2; Q errors -50/-30/-10/0/+10/+30/+50%, Moderate/Strong: 28 scenes. Used for the interim check only.
data.confirmation: F1/F2 from bae_q_20261024: exact 1D fine-layered viscoacoustic (Kennett) forward, offset 0, independent of the solver dictionary. Coherence rules have never been evaluated on them; QScan has. Same 7 Q errors x 2 noise levels: 28 scenes.

gates_confirmation.G2: mean Q0 overall-error ratio QScan+Standard / QScanRefit <= 1.02
gates_confirmation.G3: mean over (set, condition) of worst-case-over-Q ratio QScan+Standard / Standard (nominal Q) <= 0.95

development_extra: On V4/V5 also weak, fault and pinch-out ratios QScan+Standard / QScanRefit <= 1.02.
interim_switch: After V4 and F1/F2 are done: if QScan+Standard fails G1 or the development extras on the finished scenes, the combination candidate is switched to QScan+v1, then QScan+Soft (already computed, no new tuning); the first that passes is carried forward and the switch is reported.
limits: F1/F2 are 1D normal-incidence; QScan was confirmed on F1/F2 earlier, so only the coherence part is new to them. No significance claims.
